mapper.sql: SELECT o.id, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.customer_id AS customerId, c.nickname AS customerNickname, c.username AS customerUsername, c.avatar_url AS customerAvatarUrl, o.total_amount AS totalAmount, o.status, o.receiver_name AS receiverName, o.receiver_phone AS receiverPhone, o.shipping_address AS shippingAddress, o.payment_method AS paymentMethod, o.created_at AS createdAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_item oi WHERE oi.order_id = o.id) AS itemCount FROM shop_order o INNER JOIN customer c ON c.id = o.customer_id

where.if: AND ( o.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

mapper.select: SELECT id, order_no AS orderNo, customer_id AS customerId, total_amount AS totalAmount, status, receiver_name AS receiverName, receiver_phone AS receiverPhone, shipping_address AS shippingAddress, payment_method AS paymentMethod, created_at AS createdAt FROM shop_order WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shop_order o INNER JOIN customer c ON c.id = o.customer_id
ORDER BY o.created_at DESC, o.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM shop_order GROUP BY status
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM shop_order WHERE status NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'PENDING_PAY')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shop_order WHERE DATE(created_at) = CURDATE()
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM shop_order WHERE DATE(created_at) = CURDATE() AND status NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'PENDING_PAY')

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t.order_day, '%m-%d') AS day, t.orderCount, t.amount FROM ( SELECT DATE(created_at) AS order_day, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'PENDING_PAY') THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS amount FROM shop_order WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ) t ORDER BY t.order_day ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t.order_day, '%m-%d') AS day, t.orderCount, 0 AS amount FROM ( SELECT DATE(created_at) AS order_day, COUNT(*) AS orderCount FROM shop_order WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ) t ORDER BY t.order_day ASC
ORDER BY o.created_at DESC, o.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
